description: Find out how many hours of video on Graunt meet a spec, and in which categories. Give the requirements that matter (shortest side, frame rate, clip length, sound, on-screen text, overlays, first and last shots, freezes, slowed footage, releases, clearances, AI generation, uses, delivery); leave the rest out. Returns matching hours per category and per listing: hours that meet every requirement on recorded evidence, and hours that meet every requirement the evidence covers but lack evidence for one or more. Each listing carries its price, price per hour and volume tier, its delivery modes and where each number comes from. Thresholds snap to fixed steps and the answer says which were applied.

audio_checked.description: The sound runs the length of the picture, with no dual mono and no silent channel.

black_seconds_under.description: Black under this long in total (seconds): steps 0.5, 1, 2, 5.

camera_views.description: The camera view the listing declares, any of.

clip_seconds_under.description: Clip length, under (seconds), on the same steps.

color_checked.description: Color tags present and consistent, and luma inside the tagged range.

delivery_modes.description: Delivery modes, any of: DOWNLOAD from Graunt, or LINKS from the seller's storage.

edge_shot_min_seconds.description: Each clip's first and last shots last at least this long (seconds): steps 1, 2, 3, 5.

event_venue_cleared.description: Event or venue cleared or not applicable.

freeze_seconds_under.description: No frozen stretch this long or longer (seconds): steps 0.5, 1, 2, 5.

limit.description: Listings returned; default 50, cap 200. Totals and categories count every listing.

max_cuts_per_minute.description: Scene cuts a minute, at most: steps 0, 1, 2, 5, 10.

min_audio_sample_rate_hz.description: Sound sample rate, at least: steps 44100, 48000, 96000.

min_fps.description: Frames a second, at least: steps 24, 25, 30, 48, 50, 60, 120 (23.976 counts as 24).

min_listing_hours.description: Only listings with at least this many hours that meet the spec or might.

min_short_side_px.description: Shortest side of the picture, at least (pixels): steps 240, 360, 480, 720, 1080, 1440, 2160, 4320.

music_cleared.description: Music and audio cleared or not applicable.

native_only.description: Leave out clips with an upscale signal.

no_ai_generated.description: Only clips the seller declares no AI model generated.

no_identifiable_minors.description: Leave out clips the seller says show identifiable minors.

no_loops.description: Leave out clips with a stretch that repeats earlier footage.

no_slowed.description: Leave out clips with a slowed-footage signal.

overlay_share_under_pct.description: Clips with an overlay signal (a logo or watermark) stay under this share of a listing's matching hours (percent): steps 0, 5, 10, 20, 50.

people_on_camera.description: NONE: only clips with nobody on camera.

person_releases.description: Clips that show people need signed releases (SIGNED), or releases the seller holds (ON_FILE).

processed_area_under_pct.description: Black bars and fixed overlays cover under this share of the frame (percent): steps 1, 5, 10.

property_releases.description: Property releases where one is needed.

subjects.description: What the footage shows, any of.

sublicense.description: ONE_CLIENT_PREAUTHORIZED: the listing must allow buying for one client, named privately at purchase (D-651).

text_area_under_pct.description: On-screen text covers under this share of the frame (percent): steps 1, 2, 5, 10.

text_seconds_under.description: On-screen text stays on screen under this long (seconds): steps 0.5, 1, 2, 5.

third_party_ip_cleared.description: Logos and trademarks cleared or not applicable.

uses.description: Uses the listing must allow, all of.

name: match_video_spec
title: Count the hours of video that meet a spec
